headline: 5 addresses catalogued on Ethereum; limited discovery due to inaccessible website, audit PDFs, and multi-chain enumeration constraints

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search fetched SolvBTC token (0x7a56e1c57c7475ccf742a1832b028f0456652f97) and related proxy/beacon/implementation addresses on Ethereum; other chains not verified
Official website (solv.finance) inaccessible; deployed contracts documentation could not be retrieved
Audit repository confirmed (GitHub /solv-finance/Audit) with OpenZeppelin, Quanstamp, Salus, Paladin firms; PDF contents not fetched due to access restrictions
GitHub repository URL not available in protocol.github field; audit repo does not contain deployment artifacts (no Foundry broadcast/, hardhat-deploy/, or addresses.json files fetched)
Multi-chain enumeration incomplete: protocol.chains lists 8 chains (Binance, Arbitrum, Ethereum, Mantle, Polygon, Solana, Merlin, Soneium); only Ethereum addresses verified via direct Etherscan fetch
No factory contracts identified in fetched sources; SolvBTC appears to be a direct token deployment, not generated from a factory
5 addresses catalogued with roles: token (SolvBTC, SOLV), proxy_admin (beacon), admin (implementations)
All admin_addresses[] entries trace to Etherscan fetch (evidence index 2) or search results (evidence indices 1, 4, 7)

rationale.verdict: Discovery assessment limited by inaccessible website, restricted audit PDF access, and absence of GitHub repository field in protocol context. Fetched 5 Ethereum addresses with clear on-chain evidence; multi-chain discovery incomplete due to inability to enumerate explorers for Binance, Arbitrum, Polygon, Mantle, Solana, Merlin, and Soneium chains without further searches. Basis Trading vertical focus confirmed via search results but no dedicated basis trading contract addresses identified—protocol appears to offer basis trading strategies as a product/service layer on top of core SolvBTC infrastructure.

evidence.shows: SolvBTC contract address 0x7a56e1c57c7475ccf742a1832b028f0456652f97 on Ethereum via CoinGecko data

SolvBTC token (ERC-20 via BeaconProxy at 0x7a56e1c57c7475ccf742a1832b028f0456652f97) with beacon 0xFc335FdA7E6a33329A83F4d5F578eC7d8A43DC4A and implementation 0xA4b6cf2baaa235ab7fe10eadb84b82460165b38f on Ethereum; verified source code and proxy pattern
XSOLVBTC staked BTC token reference; confirms multi-chain deployment across 9 chains including Ethereum, BNB, Arbitrum, Polygon
SOLV governance token (0x256f2d67e52fe834726d2ddcd8413654f5eb8b53) on Ethereum with 100,000,000 total supply; basic ERC-20 contract
Audit repository confirms protocol audits from OpenZeppelin, Quanstamp, Salus, Paladin firms; protocol described as Bitcoin Reserve bridging TradFi/CeFi/DeFi through SolvBTC and LSTs
Protocol category and role confirmed as 'Basis Trading'; description: Solv offers advanced basis trading and hedging strategies for Bitcoin holders to generate consistent, low-risk returns

unknowns: D1: Arbitrum, Binance, Mantle, Polygon, Solana, Merlin, Soneium block explorer searches not performed (would require ≥6 additional search/fetch attempts)
D2: solv.finance website inaccessible; deployed_contracts_doc URL could not be identified
D4: protocol.github field empty; no GitHub repo URL to search for Foundry/hardhat-deploy artifacts
D3-offchain: Audit PDFs (OpenZeppelin, Quanstamp, Salus, Paladin) referenced but not fetched; contract scope tables unavailable
D6: Factory enumeration not performed; no factory method calls issued via read API (would require identifying and fetching factory addresses first)
D5: 7 of 8 pinned chains not enumerated due to tool call budget constraints and inaccessible documentation

protocol_metadata.about: Solv Basis Trading offers advanced strategies including basis trading and hedging to deliver consistent, low-risk returns for Bitcoin holders. The protocol enables users to participate in delta-neutral trading on platforms like GMX and Ethena, leveraging Bitcoin collateral to mint stablecoins and earn yields while maintaining liquidity.
